g.text: A Japanese imperial-villa sequence inside a needle hull. The forecourt frames a ceremonial view into the
ship’s actual ring station. Freight travels beneath the state rooms.
Hulls and ship capacities follow the integration branch. The four redesigns use hull-local metres. Deck links, wall openings and
passenger and repair approaches were checked on a 0.16 m grid with a 0.21 m clearance radius. Hull fit, overhead clearance
and gameplay still need a 3D blockout.
Game hulls and capacities in src/05-ships.js, src/01-data.js and
src/09-cargo.js. Existing deck geometry in art/ship-interiors/build_deck.py.
